thread:
Maya M: sharing three quick chart snapshots for the benchmark landing + webinar. link: https://figma.com/redwood/benchshots (v1, v2, v3)
Ajay K: got it — which one is best for the hero panel on the blog?
Maya M: my vote is v2 (compact token-dollar curve) for the blog, v1 for the webinar hero slide because it shows latency percentiles cleanly. v3 is for a deep-dive appendix.
Sam R: for demo routing: can we map the charts to inbound segments? SMB -> quick token-dollar snapshot, Enterprise -> percentile SLAs + dedicated pricing note.
Liz P: copy idea: "Same output quality. 3x lower token cost. Predictable latency at scale." Thoughts? :thinking_face: 
Ben E: quick numbers from infra tests: median latency 75ms, p95 240ms on dedicated pool; token cost delta depends on batch size.
Ben E: small snippet for the chart label if helpful:
```
label = f"p50={p50}ms p95={p95}ms | ${cost_per_1k:.2f}/1k tokens"
```
Maya M: love the copy. Ajay — can design expose the batch-size toggle in the interactive chart so customers see cost tradeoffs?
Ajay K: yes, we can add a slider. I'll mock it as v2a.
Sam R: webinar outline idea: 1) Why serving economics matters 2) Live demo: routing + fallback 3) Deep dive: chart explainer 4) Q&A + CTA.
Liz P: CTA variants: "Try our hosted API — free credits" vs "Request Dedicated pricing". We should A/B by org size bucket.
Maya M: inbound routing plan: landing page -> form with org-size radio -> route SMB leads to self-serve nurture, enterprise leads to sales S/G. Sam can we wire that?
Sam R: yes, will add a hidden field to the form with the chart variant seen. helps attribution.
Maya M: bench-bot posted updated perf table (automated): https://internal/redwood/bench/2719 — numbers updated this morning.
Ajay K: for the blog hero, I'll try two thumbnails: one with the token-dollar curve + single CTA, one with latency percentiles + two CTAs.
Liz P: short lines for social: "Lower token costs, predictable latency. See the numbers. 🚀" and "How we cut per-token spend without breaking SLAs." Thoughts?
Maya M: both good. prefer the second for headline, first for tweet thread.
Ben E: FYI, small caveat to include in notes: p95 spikes on mixed workloads — we have guardrail recommendations in the doc.
Maya M: noted. I'll draft the blog + webinar landing copy tonight and share for quick review. timeline: blog Wed, webinar Tues next week.
Sam R: routing + analytics wired by EOD Monday.
Ajay K: design thumbnails by EOD Tuesday.
Liz P: I'll prepare the social calendar and 3 CTA variants.
Maya M: perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
bench-bot: reaction :white_check_mark: "perf-table-updated"
